d: What if the rich could pay money to hunt human beings in the middle of a war? During the Siege of Sarajevo in the 1990s, shocking allegations emerged about wealthy foreigners travelling to Bosnia to participate in what became known as the "Sarajevo Safari", a horrifying form of alleged human hunting. Witness testimonies describe wealthy visitors paying to shoot civilians, with children allegedly fetching much higher prices than adults.
